common.back.description: Button label on Roku, for example in the Up Next panel and on screens that cannot load content. Returns to the previous screen.

common.cancel.description: Button label that dismisses a dialog, pairing prompt or confirmation without making a change. Used on phone and TV.

common.changeServer.description: Button on the TV sign-in screen and on Roku that leads to choosing or entering a different Silo server.

common.done.description: Button label that closes a finished dialog or pairing step. Used on phone and Roku.

common.loading.description: Short status text on Roku, also read aloud by the screen reader, while content is loading.

common.signOut.description: Button label that signs the current account out, including the confirm button in the sign-out dialog. Used on phone and Roku.

common.tryAgain.description: Button shown after a failed sign-in, pairing or load that repeats the attempt. Used on phone, Android TV and Roku.

common.navigateBack.description: Accessibility (TalkBack) label for the back arrow icon in a screen's top bar on the phone app. Not visible text.

common.retry.description: Button label that repeats a failed action or load, shown on error states. Used on phone and Android TV.

common.save.description: Button label that saves the changes made in a form or dialog on the phone app.

common.signIn.description: Button label that starts or submits sign-in. Title case, used on phone and Android TV.

common.signOutTitle.description: Title of the sign-out confirmation dialog on the phone app. Title case.

common.connect.description: Button on the Android TV app that connects to a server or device.

common.play.description: Button on the Android TV app that starts playback of the selected item.

setup.headline.description: Large heading on the Roku first-run screen asking for the server address. The line break splits the heading over two lines; keep it.

setup.body.description: Short helper text under the heading on the Roku server address screen, telling the user which address to type.

setup.field.description: Label of the text field on Roku where the user types the server address.

setup.placeholder.description: Example server address shown as placeholder hint in the Roku address field. Probably keep as is.

setup.connect.description: Button on the Roku server address screen that checks the address and connects to the server.

setup.connecting.description: Button or status text on Roku shown while the app is checking the entered server address.

setup.error.empty.description: Error on the Roku server address screen shown when the user submits an empty address field.

setup.error.invalidAddress.description: Error on the Roku server address screen when the entered host is not a valid address.

setup.error.unsupportedScheme.description: Error on the Roku server address screen when the address starts with something other than https:// or http://. Keep those prefixes unchanged.

setup.error.credentials.description: Error on the Roku server address screen when the address contains a user name and password, which are not allowed there.

setup.error.unreachable.description: Error on the Roku server address screen when no Silo server answers at the entered address.

setup.error.originMismatch.description: Error on the Roku server address screen when the server replied as a different address than the one entered, for example behind a proxy.

setup.cleartext.title.description: Title of a Roku warning dialog shown when the user connects to a server over plain HTTP, without encryption.

setup.cleartext.body.description: Body of the Roku unencrypted-connection warning dialog. {host}: the server address the user is about to connect to.

setup.cleartext.connect.description: Confirm button in the Roku unencrypted-connection warning dialog, to connect anyway.

setup.phone.chip.description: Small status chip with a spinner on the Roku server screen while it searches the local network for a phone or tablet running Silo.

setup.phone.headline.description: Large heading on the Roku screen offering to set up the server from a nearby phone. The line break splits it over two lines; keep it.

setup.phone.body.description: Text under the heading on the Roku phone-setup screen, explaining that using the phone avoids typing with the remote.

setup.phone.aside.description: Small lead-in text on Roku above the option to type the server address manually instead of using a phone.

setup.phone.enterAddress.description: Button on the Roku phone-setup screen that switches to typing the server address with the remote.

setup.step.open.description: First of three short numbered steps on Roku for setting up with a phone: open the Silo app on the phone.

setup.step.tap.description: Second of three numbered steps on Roku for phone setup: tap the Set Up button in the phone app. Matches the button label in setup.step.setUp.

setup.step.finish.description: Third of three numbered steps on Roku for phone setup: complete the remaining setup on the phone.

setup.step.audio.description: Screen reader text on Roku for one phone-setup step. {number}: the step number, such as 1; {title}: the text of that step.

setup.step.setUp.description: Name of the Set Up button in the Silo phone app, quoted in the Roku setup steps. Must match the phone app's button text.

setup.advanced.show.description: Toggle button on the Roku server address screen that reveals extra options for protocol and port.

setup.advanced.hide.description: Toggle button on the Roku server address screen that hides the advanced protocol and port options.

setup.scheme.auto.description: Option in the Roku advanced protocol selector that lets the app choose between HTTPS and HTTP automatically.

setup.scheme.https.description: Option in the Roku advanced protocol selector for secure connections. Protocol name, normally not translated.

setup.scheme.http.description: Option in the Roku advanced protocol selector for unencrypted connections. Protocol name, normally not translated.

setup.port.placeholder.description: Placeholder hint in the empty port field on the Roku advanced options, meaning the port is chosen automatically.

setup.port.field.description: Label of the optional server port number field in the Roku advanced options.

setup.error.invalidPort.description: Error on the Roku server address screen when the port entered is not a whole number from 1 to 65535.

setup.error.httpsOnly.description: Error on the Roku server address screen when no Silo server answers over HTTPS at the entered address and HTTPS was required.

update.headline.description: Heading on a Roku full-screen message saying the connected server software is too old for this app.

update.body.description: Body of the Roku message shown when the server runs an older Silo version that this app no longer supports.

update.originBody.description: Body of the Roku message shown when the server cannot confirm its address, so the server needs updating before signing in on Roku.

update.mismatchHeadline.description: Heading on a Roku full-screen message when the server answers from a different address than entered. The line break splits it over two lines; keep it.

update.mismatchBody.description: Body of the Roku address-mismatch message. {server}: the name or address of the server the user tried to connect to.

servers.headline.description: Heading of the Roku screen listing saved servers to switch between.

servers.body.description: Helper text under the heading of the Roku saved servers screen.

servers.add.description: Button or row on the Roku saved servers screen that starts adding another server.

servers.remove.description: Button on a saved server row on Roku that removes that server from the device.

servers.removeAudio.description: Screen reader label on Roku for the remove button of a server row. {server}: the name of that server.

servers.connecting.description: Status text on Roku shown while switching to the chosen saved server.

servers.badge.current.description: Small badge on a saved server row on Roku marking the server currently in use.

servers.badge.signedOut.description: Small badge on a saved server row on Roku showing that no account is signed in on that server.

servers.rowAudio.description: Screen reader text for a saved server row on Roku. {server}: the server name; {address}: its web address.

servers.rowAudioBadge.description: Screen reader text for a saved server row on Roku with a status badge. {server}: the server name; {address}: its web address; {badge}: the badge text, such as Current.

servers.error.unreachable.description: Error on the Roku saved servers screen when switching to a server fails because it cannot be reached. {server}: the server name.

servers.error.remove.description: Error on the Roku saved servers screen when removing a server fails. {server}: the server name.

servers.error.mismatch.description: Error on the Roku saved servers screen when a server answered from a different address. {server}: the server name.

servers.remove.title.description: Title of the Roku confirmation dialog for removing a saved server. {server}: the server name.

servers.remove.body.description: Body of the Roku remove-server dialog explaining that all accounts on that server will be signed out on this TV.

servers.remove.currentBody.description: Body of the Roku remove-server dialog when the server being removed is the active one. {server}: the server being removed; {next}: the server the TV will switch to.

servers.remove.lastBody.description: Body of the Roku remove-server dialog when it is the last saved server. {server}: the server being removed.

servers.remove.confirm.description: Confirm button in the Roku remove-server dialog that removes the server.

accounts.headline.description: Heading of the Roku screen where the user picks a server and then an account to switch to.

accounts.body.description: Helper text under the heading of the Roku change-account screen.

accounts.addAccount.description: Row on the Roku change-account screen that signs in with another account.

accounts.addAccountOn.description: Row on the Roku change-account screen to sign in on a particular server. {server}: that server's name.

accounts.addServer.description: Row on the Roku change-account screen that adds a new server.

accounts.rowAudioBadge.description: Screen reader text for an account row on the Roku change-account screen. {account}: the account name; {server}: the server it belongs to; {badge}: a status badge such as Current.

accounts.error.change.description: Error on the Roku change-account screen when switching to the chosen account fails.

accounts.addAccountOnServer.description: Row label in the phone Accounts settings to sign in with another account on a server. {server}: the server's display name.

accounts.addAServer.description: Row label in the phone Accounts settings that starts adding a new server.

accounts.remove.body.description: Body of the phone dialog for removing a server from Accounts settings. {server}: the server's display name, shown in bold.

accounts.remove.downloads.description: Extra sentence in the phone remove-server dialog about the downloads that would be deleted. {downloads}: the count as text, such as 12 downloads; {size}: their total size, such as 8.4 GB.

accounts.remove.failedBody.description: Body of the phone error dialog shown when removing a server did not finish because signing out one of its accounts failed.

accounts.remove.failedTitle.description: Title of the phone error dialog shown when removing a server failed. {server}: the server's display name.

accounts.remove.server.description: Destructive confirm button in the phone remove-server dialog.

accounts.remove.title.description: Title of the phone confirmation dialog for removing a server. {server}: the server's display name.

accounts.rename.description: Menu item in the phone Accounts settings that renames a server or account.

accounts.title.description: Title of the Accounts settings screen on the phone app, listing servers and accounts.

passwordOff.headline.description: Heading on a Roku full-screen message when the server does not allow password sign-in. The line break splits it over two lines; keep it.

passwordOff.body.description: Body of the Roku message when password sign-in is disabled. {server}: the name of the server.

notReady.headline.description: Heading on a Roku full-screen message when the server's setup has not been finished. The line break splits it over two lines; keep it.

notReady.body.description: Body of the Roku not-ready message, asking the user to have the administrator finish setup and then check again.

notReady.badge.description: Small badge on Roku marking a server that still needs administrator setup.

notReady.check.description: Button on the Roku not-ready message that checks the server's setup state again.

notReady.checking.description: Button text on Roku while the server's setup state is being rechecked.

notReady.still.description: Message on Roku after rechecking, saying the server still needs administrator setup.

notReady.unreachable.description: Message on Roku after rechecking when the server could not be reached.

signIn.headline.description: Heading of the Roku username and password sign-in screen. The line break splits it over two lines; keep it.

signIn.body.description: Helper text on the Roku password sign-in screen. {server}: the name of the server being signed in to.

signIn.username.description: Label of the user name field on the Roku sign-in screen.

signIn.password.description: Label of the password field on the Roku sign-in screen.

signIn.show.description: Short button next to the Roku password field that shows the typed password in plain text.

signIn.hide.description: Short button next to the Roku password field that hides the password again.

signIn.showPassword.description: Screen reader label on Roku for the button that reveals the password.

signIn.hidePassword.description: Screen reader label on Roku for the button that hides the password.

signIn.submit.description: Button on the Roku password sign-in screen that submits the user name and password.

signIn.submitting.description: Button text on the Roku sign-in screen while the sign-in request is in progress.

signIn.error.username.description: Validation error under the user name field on the Roku sign-in screen when it is empty.

signIn.error.password.description: Validation error under the password field on the Roku sign-in screen when it is empty.

signIn.error.invalid.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen when the user name or password is wrong.

signIn.error.rateLimited.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen when the server blocks sign-in because of too many attempts.

signIn.error.network.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen when a network problem prevented sign-in.

signIn.error.disabled.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen when the account has been disabled by an administrator.

signIn.error.unavailable.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen when the sign-in service cannot be reached.

signIn.error.passwordOff.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen when the server has turned off password sign-in.

signIn.error.notPermitted.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen when the account is not allowed to use this server.

signIn.error.passwordExpired.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen when the account password has expired and must be changed elsewhere.

signIn.error.emailInUse.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen: an account with this email already exists and an admin must link it to the external sign-in provider.

signIn.error.linkedElsewhere.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen: the external sign-in provider account is already linked to a different Silo account.

signIn.error.accountRequired.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen: the person has no account on this server and an admin must add one.

signIn.error.failed.description: Generic fallback error on the Roku sign-in screen when login fails for an unknown reason.

signIn.error.providers.description: Error on the Roku sign-in screen when the server could not be contacted to load sign-in options. {server}: the server name.

signIn.code.headline.description: Heading of the Roku code sign-in screen, which shows a QR code and a short code. {server}: the server name.

signIn.code.lead.description: Instruction on the Roku code sign-in screen: scan the QR code or visit a web page and enter the code. {page}: the address of the page to visit, or the phrase from signIn.code.leadNoPage.

signIn.code.leadEnded.description: Instruction on the Roku code sign-in screen after the code expired or ended, when password sign-in is also available.

signIn.code.leadEndedNoPassword.description: Instruction on the Roku code sign-in screen after the code expired or ended, when password sign-in is not available.

signIn.code.leadNoPage.description: Phrase on Roku that fills the page slot in the code sign-in instruction when no page address is known. It must read naturally in place of a web address. Keep /activate unchanged.

signIn.code.nearby.description: Hint on the Roku code sign-in screen suggesting the user open the Silo phone app on the same Wi-Fi network to sign in this TV.

signIn.code.usePassword.description: Button on the Roku code sign-in screen that switches to user name and password sign-in.

signIn.code.showNewCode.description: Button on the Roku code sign-in screen that requests a fresh code.

signIn.code.usePhone.description: Button on Roku that switches from typing to signing in with a nearby phone.

signIn.code.qrAudio.description: Screen reader text on Roku for the sign-in QR code. {page}: the web page address to visit; {code}: the short code to enter there.

signIn.status.gettingCode.description: Status line on the Roku code sign-in screen while a sign-in code is being requested.

signIn.status.waiting.description: Status line on the Roku code sign-in screen while waiting for the user to approve the sign-in on another device.

signIn.status.renewed.description: Status line on Roku shown when a new sign-in code replaced the old one and approval is awaited.

signIn.status.opened.description: Status line on Roku shown after the user opened the sign-in page on their phone, telling them to continue there.

signIn.status.approvedAs.description: Status line on Roku after sign-in was approved on another device. {account}: the name of the account signed in.

signIn.status.approved.description: Status line on Roku after sign-in was approved, used when the account name is unknown.

signIn.status.couldNotFinish.description: Status line on Roku when approval succeeded but the TV could not complete the sign-in.

signIn.status.denied.description: Status line on Roku when the person declined the sign-in request on their phone.

signIn.status.paused.description: Status line on Roku when code sign-in is paused, for example because the app was in the background.

signIn.status.unreachable.description: Status line on the Roku code sign-in screen when the server cannot be reached. {server}: the server name.

signIn.status.rateLimited.description: Status line on the Roku code sign-in screen when the server asked for fewer requests; the app will retry automatically.

signIn.status.failed.description: Generic status line on the Roku code sign-in screen for an unexpected failure.

signIn.passwordOnly.description: Note on the Roku sign-in screen explaining the server offers only password sign-in, with no code or phone option.

signIn.phoneHint.description: Hint on the Roku password sign-in screen for accounts that use an external provider. {name}: the provider's name, such as the identity service.

signIn.phoneHintSso.description: Hint on the Roku password sign-in screen for accounts that use single sign-on, when no provider name is known.

signIn.expired.description: Message on the Roku sign-in screen shown when the saved session ended. {server}: the server name.

firstRun.help.title.description: Title of a Roku help popup on the first-run screens about typing text more easily.

firstRun.help.body.description: Body of the Roku typing help popup: select a field, then type with the remote or the Roku mobile app keyboard on the same network.

firstRun.badge.secure.description: Small badge on Roku next to a server address meaning the connection is encrypted (HTTPS).

firstRun.badge.http.description: Small badge on Roku next to a server address meaning the connection uses plain HTTP. Protocol name, usually not translated.

firstRun.badge.update.description: Small badge on Roku next to a server that needs a software update before it can be used.

firstRun.badge.mismatch.description: Small badge on Roku next to a server whose reply came from a different address than expected.

profiles.headline.description: Heading of the Roku profile picker screen, asking which person is watching.

profiles.signedInAs.description: Subtitle on the Roku profile picker screen. {name}: the name of the signed-in account.

profiles.pinProtected.description: Screen reader text on Roku for a profile tile that needs a PIN to open.

profiles.kidsProfile.description: Screen reader text on Roku for a profile tile that is a children's profile.

profiles.kids.description: Small uppercase badge on a Roku profile tile marking a children's profile. Keep it very short.

profiles.empty.description: Message on the Roku profile picker when the account has no profiles; the user must add one in the web app.

profiles.error.load.description: Error on the Roku profile picker when profiles could not be loaded.

profiles.error.passwordChange.description: Error on the Roku profile picker when the account must set a new password in the web app before use.

profiles.error.select.description: Error on the Roku profile picker when the chosen profile could not be opened.

profiles.add.description: Tile or button on the Roku profile picker that opens the add choices (profile, account or server).

profiles.changeAccount.description: Button on the Roku profile picker that opens the change-account screen.

profiles.addChoice.title.description: Title of the Roku dialog asking what to add: a profile, an account or a server.

profiles.addChoice.profile.description: Option in the Roku add dialog for adding a profile to the current account.

profiles.addChoice.profileDetail.description: Secondary line under the Roku add-a-profile option.

profiles.addChoice.account.description: Option in the Roku add dialog for signing in with another account.

profiles.addChoice.accountDetail.description: Secondary line under the Roku add-an-account option.

profiles.addChoice.server.description: Option in the Roku add dialog for adding another Silo server.

profiles.addChoice.serverDetail.description: Secondary line under the Roku add-a-server option.

profiles.signInAgain.description: Button on the Roku profile picker shown when the session ended, to sign in again.

launch.offer.title.description: Title of a Roku dialog offering to skip the profile picker next time. {name}: the profile name.

launch.offer.body.description: Body of the Roku auto-open dialog. Mentions a path in Roku settings, Settings > General > Profile Selection; keep that path consistent with the app's settings labels.

launch.offer.remember.description: Button in the Roku auto-open dialog that opens this profile automatically from now on.

launch.offer.ask.description: Button in the Roku auto-open dialog that keeps showing the profile picker at each start. Title case.

pin.prompt.description: Prompt on the Roku PIN entry screen for a protected profile.

pin.checking.description: Status text on the Roku PIN screen while the entered PIN is being verified.

pin.audio.description: Screen reader prompt on the Roku PIN screen. {name}: the profile name.

pin.wrong.description: Error on the Roku PIN screen when the PIN entered is incorrect.

pin.lockout.description: Error on the Roku PIN screen after too many wrong PINs; counts the minutes the user must wait. {minutes}: the number of minutes.

pin.lockout.later.description: Error on the Roku PIN screen after too many wrong PINs when the wait time is unknown.

pin.error.network.description: Error on the Roku PIN screen when a network problem prevented checking the PIN.

pin.error.failed.description: Error on the Roku PIN screen when the PIN check failed for another reason.
